description:
Diagnose the crawl depth of a specific product on https://books.toscrape.com/. 

STEPS:
1. Crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'.
2. Locate the product page for the book "It's Only the Himalayas" (URL ends in `its-only-the-himalayas_981/index.html`).
3. Export the 'Crawl Path Report' for this specific URL. To do this, find the URL in the Internal tab, right-click it, select 'Export', then 'Crawl Path Report'.
4. Save the CSV as `~/Documents/SEO/exports/himalayas_path.csv`.
5. examine the 'Crawl Depth' or the length of the path. Write the depth number (e.g., 2, 3, 4) into a text file at `~/Documents/SEO/reports/depth_value.txt`.

SUCCESS CRITERIA: A valid Crawl Path CSV export for the target book and a text file containing the correct depth integer.
